# Meal excursions: T1DMSIM vs. a self-dosed UVA/Padova patient

Companion to [`README.md`](README.md). That report replays T1DMSIM's insulin
into UVA/Padova verbatim; the boluses, sized by T1DMSIM's aggressive
insulin-to-carb ratio, over-cover the UVA virtual patients and drive them into
sustained hypoglycaemia, so the comparison is dominated by a gross level
mismatch. Here that confound is removed: the engines **share only the meal
schedule**, and each doses insulin for its own physiology.

*Generated by `uva_padova/compare_excursions.py`. Do not edit by hand.*

## Method

For each of 40 seeds, T1DMSIM generates a virtual patient and a
14-day schedule. The food-meal times and grams it produces are shared
with a paired UVA/Padova `adult` patient; insulin is then **not**
shared. T1DMSIM doses as it normally would (behavioural under-counting, missed
boluses, corrections, timing jitter and all); the UVA/Padova patient is dosed
for its own physiology — own basal (u2ss) + grams/CR meal bolus + bounded CF correction. With both engines in a normal
operating range, isolated post-meal excursions (≥25 g, no
other ≥20 g meal within ±120 min so the rise and peak
are clean, a 180-min window) are extracted
relative to each engine's **own** pre-meal baseline, so what is compared is the
*response*, not the level. 813 excursions met the criteria.

## Excursion amplitude and timing (median, IQR)

| Quantity | T1DMSIM | UVA/Padova |
|---|---|---|
| Peak rise (mg/dL) | 46 (10–95) | 37 (24–51) |
| Time-to-peak (min) | 100 (40–170) | 75 (60–90) |
| 3-h excursion area (mg/dL·min) | 3830 (381–10749) | 3608 (2116–5501) |
| Recovery to baseline (min) | 180 (50–180) | 145 (105–180) |

Per-meal paired differences (T1DMSIM − UVA/Padova): peak rise
**+10** mg/dL
(IQR -20–+55),
time-to-peak **+20** min
(IQR -35–+80).

## Excursion shape (amplitude removed)

Normalising each excursion by its own peak sets the two engines to a common
amplitude, leaving only the *shape* — how fast glucose rises and how it returns.

![Peak-normalised excursion shape](figures/excursion_shape_normalized.png)

## Reproducing

```bash
pip install --no-deps simglucose>=0.2.11
venv/bin/python uva_padova/compare_excursions.py            # full run
venv/bin/python uva_padova/compare_excursions.py --quick    # fast smoke run
```
